keyEvents.text: Goal! Sassuolo 1, Fiorentina 0. Armand Laurienté (Sassuolo) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Sebastiano Esposito with a through ball following a fast break.
Ibrahim Sulemana (Sassuolo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Radu Dragusin (Fiorentina) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alieu Njie (Fiorentina) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sassuolo 1, Fiorentina 1. Mateo Pellegrino (Fiorentina) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Alieu Njie.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Darryl Bakola replaces Ibrahim Sulemana.
Goal! Sassuolo 1, Fiorentina 2. Alieu Njie (Fiorentina) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Marco Brescianini.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Kieron Bowie replaces Vasilije Adzic.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Christ Inao Oulaï replaces Nicolò Fagioli.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Wilfried Gnonto replaces Alieu Njie.

Goal! Sassuolo 2, Fiorentina 2. Armand Laurienté (Sassuolo) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the top right corner. Assisted by Nemanja Matic.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Beto replaces Mateo Pellegrino.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Pote replaces Marco Brescianini.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Simone Cinquegrano replaces Sebastian Walukiewicz.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Rafa Obrador replaces Josh Doig.
Goal! Sassuolo 2, Fiorentina 3. Franco Mastantuono (Fiorentina) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Pote.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Gabriel Kulla replaces Sebastiano Esposito.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Valde replaces Franco Mastantuono.
Wilfried Gnonto (Fiorentina) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sassuolo 2, Fiorentina 4. Valde (Fiorentina) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Cher Ndour following a fast break.
Gabriel Kulla (Sassuolo) is shown the yellow card.
